corrections.original_standard_title: Technical drawings — Construction drawings — General rules for execution of production drawings for prefabricated structural components
corrections.why_wrong: ISO 7437:1990 is a technical drawing standard for prefabricated structural components. It has NOTHING to do with medical devices, biocompatibility, or CSF shunts. It was incorrectly cited in R370B as a biocompatibility and CSF shunt standard.
corrections.replacement: ISO 7197:2024 (for CSF shunt device requirements) and ISO 10993 series (for biocompatibility)
corrections.source_verification: https://www.iso.org/standard/14173.html (ISO 7437 catalog page confirms it is a technical drawing standard)
corrections.corrective_action: All ISO 7437 citations replaced with ISO 7197 (CSF shunt context) or removed (biocompatibility context, where ISO 10993 already cited). Standard register updated to include ISO 7197 as the correct CSF shunt standard.
corrections.lesson: Standards must be verified by ID against the issuing body's catalog, not by name similarity. ISO 7437 (technical drawings) and ISO 7197 (CSF shunts) are completely different standards despite similar numbers.
corrections.constitution_reference: Article II (exact evidence beats semantic plausibility), Article VI (never manufacture provenance)

history_metadata.purpose: Audit trail of wrong standards previously cited, separated from primary register to prevent accidental consumption
history_metadata.constitution_compliance: Article XXXI (every correction creates a memory artifact)
